page.overview:
What is Mokomo Dukedom?

The Mokomo Dukedom is the civilization developed by the Mink Tribe on the living island of Zou in the New World. In the past, it was led by Hitsugisukan, who was succeeded by the "Ruler of Day," Duke Inuarashi, and the "Ruler of Night," Master Nekomamushi. The two rulers then retired at the end of Wano Country Arc to become Kouzuki Momonosuke's retainers, entrusting the nation to Carrot.

As a dukedom, the country is ruled by a , but the line of succession is decided by merit rather than bloodline, as the current duke can pass rulership to anyone else in their tribe should they prove themselves worthy of it.

In the past, this title belonged to Hitsugisukan. The title was then passed on to Inuarashi, making him the official sovereign of the kingdom. However, Nekomamushi possessed equal authority as the of the Whale Forest. The leadership was divided between the two, so each reigned for 12 hours: Inuarashi from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM as the "Ruler of Day," and Nekomamushi from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM as the "Ruler of Night." This division also affected the sleeping habits of the citizens, with townsfolk being diurnal while the forestfolk are nocturnal. Communication between the two rulers was handled by special aides known as ; the only official ones being Wanda and Carrot. The country also has two combat forces: the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad led by Shishilian and the Guardians formerly led by Pedro. After a decisive battle at Onigashima, Inuarashi and Nekomamushi pass on their authority over to Carrot due to her experience out at sea with the Straw Hat Pirates.

The Mokomo Dukedom is comprised of a sprawling city with several of its ancient buildings embedded in the surrounding rock formations and an area known as the Whale Forest that features a large whale-shaped tree. The entirety of the back is encircled by a large wall, with a gate located near Zunesha's tail.
